title: Native derived direct image commutes with restriction to an open subscheme
statement: Fix a prime $l$ and a Cartesian square $a:U'\to U$, $j':U'\to Z'$, $j:U\to Z$, $f:Z'\to Z$, with $j,j'$ open immersions. For the ordinary unbounded native adic derived categories [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], define the canonical isomorphism $D(j^*)Rf_*\simeq Ra_*D(j'^*)$ by right deriving the native underived open-base-change isomorphism and composing with the universal derived-composition comparisons. Open restriction is computed termwise.
